about: Store screenshot captions for T77 (store/svg). English source: docs/STORE.md section 3. Other locales are machine translation awaiting native review, like the app catalogues (docs/I18N.md); verbs follow each catalogue's home.tagline wording. The SVGs carry the English captions; localised sets swap in these strings.

ar.mirroring: Mirror the whole composition for Arabic: headline and subtitle right-aligned or centred with RTL shaping, phone and pop-ups swap sides, curved arrows and the hand flip horizontally, phone screens show the right-to-left UI (tab order reversed, as on the Arabic phone in 08-languages style b). Do not mirror digits, the 65% bubble, template line art or Latin-script samples.
